evaluation.heldout_download_note: PKDDtest downloaded after first technical pilot, before second study freeze; no parsing/scoring until fixed300update study finished. Keep this distinction from download-after-freeze.

findings: Large-model capacity is not the missing prerequisite. Original9.68M versus253k had weak lab campaign independence and high APpilot; fresh full3source transfer shows GLU FPR73.22% versus MLP5.52% on the common payload task at their frozen old thresholds. This is evidence against deployment, not a causal architecture ablation.

Dual-projection audit: oldv2 selected payload lexical counters are zero for all288new payload attacks using nonallowlisted parameter names; requestv1 retains numeric grammar signals before masking. query_lexical_available alone was misleading because safe page/limit remained. Legacy semantics not overwritten.

New70feature supervised corpus collapses to1233unique labelled labviews,1027positive. Twoepochs only20updates. Fixed300update diagnostic improves validation AP/recall but does not create new independent information or solve scenario memorization.

GLU OOD benign scores near1 force worst-source calibration threshold0.998768. Despite validation AP0.8071 and freshlabAP0.8080, operating-point freshlab recall is0. MLP threshold0.967558 yields40.625%recall with0/1378FP. Do not lower a threshold based on fresh test labels.

AE learns benign views fromthree sources and reaches public PKDD40.21%recall/FPR0.1047%, but on new lab hardnegatives FPR18.58%. It is not a champion. Public precision99.82% is measured at59%attackprevalence and does not establish production precision.

Feature collision audit:600crosspartition generic numericviewgroups, zero mixed0/1label groups in fitting corpus; rawviewcollisions do not prove identical requests or grammar independence. Public/new cohort tests report full and novelview subsets without dropping difficult examples.

Observed underoptimization, masking loss, source calibration shift and thin positive support are distinct evidence. Multi-seed architecture-isolation, independent labels and multi-environment collection remain required; cannot attribute all failure to one mechanism.
